title: EasyWaypoints
description: A lightweight, easy-to-use, modern, and highly optimized waypoint mod for Fabric, designed to integrate seamlessly with both vanilla Minecraft and performance-focused setups using Sodium, Iris, and custom shaders.
body:
An easy-to-use, modern, and highly optimized waypoint mod for Fabric, designed to integrate seamlessly with both vanilla Minecraft and performance-focused setups using Sodium, Iris, and custom shaders.
## Features
* **Toggle Mode:** 3 switchable display modes (Classic, LocatorBar, off) with key k (`K`)
* **Hide or Focus:** Instantly hide a specific waypoint, or activate Focus Mode to vanish all others and lock your eyes on a single target
* **Nether-Overworld Coordinate Translation:** Toggling dimension sharing (`⇄`) automatically displays Overworld waypoints in the Nether (scaled by 1:8) and Nether waypoints in the Overworld (scaled by 8:1). Perfect for building nether highway links!
* **One-Click Chat Sharing:** A dedicated share button in the waypoint list instantly formats and sends a waypoint's coordinates and dimension name to the public server chat.
* **Shader & Sodium Compatible:** Built using native Minecraft rendering structures to prevent visual glitches under Iris/Sodium.
## Installation & Requirements
* **Loader:** Fabric Loader (>= 0.19.3)
* **API:** Fabric API
* **Compatibility:** Fully compatible with Sodium, Iris, and custom shaders.
## Supported Languages
* English 🇺🇸
* Español 🇪🇸
